messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty page fired: PAGER-4523 — trigger=embeddings-queue-5xx, severity=P2, region=eu-west-1. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PAGER-4523
IncidentBot: Incident bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/4523 — auto-acked by Elena.
Elena: ack. I'm on it, joining bridge now and tailing logs. grabbing recent request traces.
Sam: thx. if you want me to take ownership tell me — can handle customer comms so you can dig.
Elena: @Sam pls take customer updates. I'll look at the embedder pods and kvcache.
Miguel: available to assist with kvcache and node metrics. ping me if you want me to run heap/profile.
Jess: FYI support flagged a customer spike reporting 502s + timeouts at 14:01 UTC — ticket #3456 — attaching snippet.
Jess: ```
Timestamp: 2026-03-17T14:01:32Z
Error: 502 Bad Gateway
Endpoint: /v1/embeddings
Latency: p95 1200ms
```
Elena: running `kubectl logs -n inference svc-embedder-0 --since=10m` — seeing repeated 5xx from grpc: "kv cache miss -> backend timeout". Looks like a thin circuit.
Miguel: checking node metrics: mem spike on embedder-2 and increased read latency to Redis proxy. Could be transient read amplification.
Sam: @CustomerSuccess I posted an initial message to customer: short ack + we're investigating, ETA 15m. :white_check_mark:
CustomerSuccess: Confirmed, customer acknowledged. They're seeing degraded production embedding throughput, affecting search relevance.
Elena: I'm going to trigger failover to warm pool for embedder replicas to reduce latency while we investigate. Command: `infra embedder failover --pool warm-eu --target svc-embedder`
Sam: taking ownership now — I'm the active responder. Elena handing off live investigation. I'll post updates every 5m. @Elena keep me posted if you need me to escalate infra. :thumbsup:
Elena: handoff acknowledged. I'll stay on the bridge for 10m while failover completes then hand fully to Miguel for postmortem traces.
Miguel: after failover completes I'll collect heap profiles + kv latency traces: `redis-cli --latency -h proxy-eu` and `perf top` on embedder-2.
Sam: 2m update: failover triggered; new replicas coming up, p95 latency down ~30% in our quick check. Customer reported partial recovery.
CustomerSuccess: Customer confirms some requests are succeeding again, still seeing occasional 502. They appreciate the quick update.
Elena: noted — continuing trace correlation, looks like a specific code path produces huge memory churn on embedder when input batch size spikes. Putting a temporary rate-limit on batch size at the router: `router.conf max_batch=64`
Sam: 10m update: temporary rate-limit applied, failover stabilized workers, customer impact greatly reduced. I'm going to let Miguel handle the deep analysis and keep monitoring. If anything spikes I'll re-claim.
Miguel: will take postmortem ownership. I'll collect core dumps and open an incident runbook draft.
Sam: thanks team. Closing loop with customer in 30m with full update. Dropping off bridge. :wave:
Elena: thanks all — great quick handoff. +1 for the new failover automation working as intended.
IncidentBot: Incident PAGER-4523 status changed: acknowledged -> mitigated (partial). Owner: Sam. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/incidents/PAGER-4523
Sam: logging final note here and will create follow-up ticket for root-cause and rollout fix.
